title: Mendfinity
description: Allows you to combine Mending/Infinity in an anvil like any other enchantment.
body:
It's debated whether or not making Mending and Infinity exclusive was the right call. If you preferred being able to combine them, this datapack is for you! Simply use an anvil to combine items with the enchantments like you would any other, and the game won't stop you.

![Anvil showing a Mending and Infinity book able to be combined in survival.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/wa0Xg7Zd/images/5311bab319bf68059f8e462c063fb5539cc8173f.png)
